'''Hunter/killer droids''' were spherical floating [[Droid/Legends|droids]] equipped with a single [[Color/Legends|red]] sensor and three [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. They were used to track down targets and guard sensitive areas. [[Xucphra Corporation]] used them on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] as of [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].
